Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> The category of constructible sheaves of sets
is closed under finite limits and colimits inside <MATH_0002>.
<STRUCT_0003> The category of constructible abelian sheaves is a
weak Serre subcategory of <MATH_0003>.
<STRUCT_0004> Let <MATH_0004> be a Noetherian ring. The category of
constructible sheaves of <MATH_0005>-modules on
<MATH_0006> is a weak Serre subcategory of
<MATH_0007>.
<STRUCT_0005>

We prove (3). We will use the criterion of
Homology, Lemma <REF_0001>.
Suppose that <MATH_0001>
is a map of constructible sheaves of <MATH_0002>-modules.
We have to show that <MATH_0003> and
<MATH_0004> are constructible. 
Similarly, suppose that
<MATH_0005>
is a short exact sequence of sheaves of <MATH_0006>-modules
with <MATH_0007>, <MATH_0008> constructible. We have to show
that <MATH_0009> is constructible.
In both cases we can replace <MATH_0010> with the members of an
affine open covering. Hence we may assume <MATH_0011> is affine.
Then we may further replace <MATH_0012> by the members of a finite
partition of <MATH_0013> by constructible locally closed subschemes
on which <MATH_0014> and <MATH_0015> are of finite type and
locally constant. Thus we may apply
Lemma <REF_0002> to conclude.

<STRUCT_0001><STRUCT_0002>
The proofs of (1) and (2) are very similar and are omitted.
